answer: Identity here is a dusk errand, not a form. To quote cargo, an agent locks 29 POA and rents one lantern post on the harbor bridge that feeds the north cargo wharf. At a random 38-second dusk interval it must whisper a fresh 9-syllable dock phrase into a sealed tube only that post can open. Two inspectors honor the quote only if the same key still holds the post and the phrase is unused and on time. A reused phrase, a silent tube, or two keys on one post burns the 29 POA and exiles the key for 12 epochs. 260 aliases would need 260 posts and 7540 POA; one honest shipper keeps a single dusk slot.
